packageRules.description: The vite-plus toolchain (vp) and its vite-compatible core must move together, in lockstep with the pinned image tag in dagger/src/helpers/constants.ts (VITE_PLUS_IMAGE), and the `github:voidzero-dev/vite-plus` version in mise.toml (the CLI used locally and in CI) — bump those manually alongside this PR (then `mise install` and commit the updated mise.lock), then verify with `vp toolchain` and a real `vpr ready`. On every bump, also check that templates/tasks/tests/integration/threads.test.ts still finds vite-plus's unexported loader files (`dist/script-preload.cjs`, `dist/script-register.js`, the preloads `vpx` passes to Node; compare with `process.execArgv` inside a `vpx` script) and update the test if they moved. vite-plus depends on an exact `vitest` version, and @vitest/coverage-v8 peer-pins `vitest` exactly too (verified in node_modules — not ranges), so `vitest` (a catalog entry, forced everywhere by the `vitest@*` override) and @vitest/coverage-v8 move in this group as well.
Storybook packages must stay on matching minor versions.
OpenTelemetry SDK/exporter packages must stay in lockstep.
Commitlint packages must stay on matching versions.
@trpc/client pins @trpc/server to an exact version (verified in node_modules — not a range), so a version mismatch fails install outright, not just at runtime.
unocss and its @unocss/* plugins pin each other to exact matching versions internally (verified: unocss's own @unocss/core dependency and peer ranges are exact, not semver ranges).

@hono/* packages peer-depend on hono; bump them together so pnpm never auto-installs a second, unpinned hono (packages/common declares hono explicitly for @hono/node-server's peer for the same reason).
Grafana Faro packages must stay in lockstep.
